name: librejustice
description: The LibreJustice MCP connector and its skills: free French legal research, case law from France's administrative and judicial courts, and legislation as it stood on any date.

plugins.name: librejustice
plugins.description: Free and open source, LibreJustice gives your agent ~5 million decisions from French, European, Swiss, Belgian, Luxembourg, Dutch and African courts, linked article by article to ~2.1 million legal articles and their ~1.8 million past versions. It also searches 24 official journals. The plugin carries six MCP tools over OAuth and two research skills.
